title: Harder Progression
description: This Mod Chages Vinilla MineCraft Recpies And OverHaul's Iron Tools and way to get iron and Also Chages Recipes of Diamond Tier Items
body:
This mod changes how you get iron in Minecraft to make the game more challenging.

**No more easy iron**: When you mine iron ore, it drops dust instead of the regular stuff.

**Pickaxe matters**: You need specific, better tools to get the iron out of the ground.

**More work to do**: You have to process the dust before you can use it.

**Better early game**: This makes the beginning of the game last longer and gives you more to do.
